physical_subject: Why do staggered rows of equal circles leave less empty space?
relationship: Square and triangular circle lattices have cell areas 4r² and 2√3r², hence cover fractions π/4 and π/(2√3).
operation: Settle alternate rows, enlarge a triangle of touching centers, and compare repeating-cell heights and coverage.
closest_prior: Why bee use hexagons; garden fixed perimeter
substantive_difference: Equal-circle lattice density via touching-center triangle, not honeycomb perimeter efficiency or rectangle-area optimization.
